title: 第6章 选婚比武

content_zh:
吴媚儿，是青阳镇吴家村村长的孙女，其美貌有着青阳镇第一美女之称。当初萧叶还是萧家村第一天才的时候，吴媚儿对他特别热情，毫不掩饰其仰慕之意，但是被萧叶拒绝了。
没想到，眨眼之间就对萧腾投怀送抱了，对于这种女人，萧叶发自心底的厌恶。
“势利的女人啊……”萧叶摇了摇头，正准备转身离开。
这时，远方拥挤的人群自动分开，萧腾携着一位少女走了出来。
那少女年方十四岁上下，面容妩媚，身姿婀娜，秋水般的眸子，闪动勾人夺魄的光泽。比之柳依依的清丽脱俗，这少女身上多了一份妩媚。
萧腾与吴媚儿并肩而行，衣袂飘飘，男情妾意，宛如一对璧人。
“嗯？萧叶！”突然，萧腾脚步停顿，目光凝固。
听到萧腾的话，所有人目光都汇聚到萧叶身上，窃窃私语声响起。
“萧叶居然醒了！”
“醒了又如何？他的地位已经被萧腾取代了。”
有人表情错愕，然而更多的人表情玩味。
昔日萧家村的第一天才，和现在的第一天才，居然在这样的情况下相遇了。
眼见被发现，萧叶索性大大方方的现身。
“腾哥，我们走吧。”吴媚儿看着萧叶，脸上露出厌恶的神色。
看到萧叶，她就想到当初自己主动追求对方的模样。如果萧叶依旧是第一天才那倒没什么，但他已经不是了。
被一个失去光环的家伙拒绝，吴媚儿心底自然会产生厌恶。
“萧叶，我听说你还没收到一张亲帖吧？”萧腾嘴角含着一丝嘲讽，但目光中却有着寒芒在涌动，他深刻记得，当初萧叶将他击败的那一幕。
“正好，我收到的亲帖太多，不如我送给你一些，如何？”萧腾说着，示威性的牵住吴媚儿的小手，满脸得意。
他现在是萧家村第一天才，青阳镇第一美女也站在自己这边，萧叶拿什么跟自己斗！
萧叶嗤笑一声，萧腾是白痴吗？他以为牵着吴媚儿的手，就能激怒自己吗？

他萧叶，可从未对吴媚儿这样的女人动心过，以前没有，以后也不会有。
“抱歉，别人不要的东西，我萧叶也不会要。倒是你萧腾，一直在捡我不要的东西，比如炼体丹，又比如蛟蛇血，再比如她。”萧叶说到最后，目光扫了吴媚儿一眼，意思很明显。
萧腾脸色立刻变了，身躯愤怒得颤抖起来，恨不得生吞了萧叶。
他想在言语在反击，但是想了半天，也没想到合适的言辞，反而将脸色憋的通红。
“萧叶，你有什么资格这么说我，你已经不是萧家村第一天才，你骂。
身为青阳镇第一美女的脸面，岂容萧叶随意侮辱？但这泼辣的性格，却让人暗暗摇头。
萧叶懒得和吴媚儿斗嘴，直接转身离去。
“萧叶！”萧腾愤怒大吼，“希望两天后的选婚，你不要当只缩头乌龟！”
若是萧家村有村规，小辈之间不得随意打斗，他早就扑上去将萧叶撕成碎片了。
萧叶没有回头，淡淡的话语传入萧腾的耳中：“选婚擂台上，我等你。”
“萧叶要参加选婚！”围观的人倒吸一口凉气。
没有收到一张亲帖，却去参加选婚，这得有多大的勇气啊。
萧叶回到自己的房间，盘膝坐在床上，念头稍动，体内的真气便在经脉中奔腾。
“我现在已经突破到后天境一重，要想继续提升，还得弄一套后天功法。”萧叶思索道。
基础战技猛虎拳，只能淬炼肉体，对于壮大体内真气，没有丝毫帮助。
后天功法，可以淬炼、壮大体内的真气，萧家村内“算了，等选婚大会之后再去领取吧。”萧叶自语道。反正离选婚大会只有短短两天了，他也不急于一时。
第三天的清晨，当太阳投射下第一缕光束的时候，坐在床上的萧叶睁开双眼，然后推门走了出来。
门外，萧阳与罗梅兰早就准备好了。
“叶儿，你确定要去参加选婚？”萧阳再次问道。
没有收到一张亲帖却去参加选婚，这绝对会成为他人的笑柄。他倒是无所谓，他就怕萧叶受不了这种打击。

“爹娘，放心吧，我没事。”萧叶淡淡一笑，眸光清澈，他低声道，“过了今天，绝对没人再敢嘲笑我们。”

content_en:
Wu Meier is the granddaughter of the head of Wujia Village in Qingyang Town. Her beauty is known as the most beautiful woman in Qingyang Town. When Xiao Ye was still the number one genius in Xiaojia Village, Wu Meier was particularly enthusiastic about him and made no secret of her admiration for him, but she was rejected by Xiao Ye.
Unexpectedly, he fell in love with Xiao Teng in the blink of an eye. Xiao Ye hated this kind of woman from the bottom of his heart.
"Snobbish woman..." Xiao Ye shook his head and was about to turn around and leave.
At this time, the crowded crowd in the distance parted automatically, and Xiao Teng walked out with a girl.
The girl was about fourteen years old, with a charming face, graceful figure, and eyes like autumn water, flashing with a seductive luster. Compared with Liu Yiyi's pure and refined beauty, this girl has an extra charm.
Xiao Teng and Wu Meier walked side by side, their clothes fluttering, and they were in love with each other, just like a couple.
"Huh? Xiao Ye!" Suddenly, Xiao Teng stopped and his eyes froze.
After hearing Xiao Teng's words, everyone's eyes focused on Xiao Ye, and whispers began.
"Xiao Ye actually woke up!"
"So what if he wakes up? His position has been replaced by Xiao Teng."
Some people looked surprised, but more people looked amused.
The number one genius in Xiaojia Village in the past and the number one genius now actually met under such circumstances.
Seeing that he was discovered, Xiao Ye simply showed up openly.
"Brother Teng, let's go." Wu Mei'er looked at Xiao Ye with a look of disgust on her face.
Seeing Xiao Ye, she thought of how she took the initiative to pursue him. It would be okay if Xiao Ye was still the number one genius, but he was no longer.
Being rejected by a guy who has lost his halo, Wu Meier will naturally feel disgust in her heart.
"Xiao Ye, I heard that you haven't received a wedding invitation yet, right?" Xiao Teng had a hint of ridicule in the corner of his mouth, but there was a cold light in his eyes. He deeply remembered the scene when Xiao Ye defeated him.
"Just in time, I have received too many wedding invitations, how about I give you some?" Xiao Teng said, holding Wu Meier's little hand in a demonstrative manner, with a proud face.
He is now the number one genius in Xiaojia Village, and the number one beauty in Qingyang Town is also on his side. What can Xiao Ye do to fight with him!
Xiao Ye sneered, is Xiao Teng an idiot? Did he think that holding Wu Meier's hand would anger him?
He, Xiao Ye, has never been tempted by a woman like Wu Meier. He has never been tempted before and will never be in the future.
"Sorry, I, Xiao Ye, don't want things that others don't want. It's you, Xiao Teng, who has been picking up things that I don't want, such as body refining pills, snake blood, and her." When Xiao Ye finished speaking, he glanced at Wu Mei'er, and the meaning was obvious.
Xiao Teng's expression immediately changed, his body trembled with rage, and he wished he could eat Xiao Ye alive.
He wanted to fight back with words, but after thinking for a long time, he couldn't think of the right words. Instead, his face turned red.
"Xiao Ye, what qualifications do you have to say that to me? You are no longer the number one genius in Xiaojia Village. You are scolding me.
As the most beautiful woman in Qingyang Town, how could Xiao Ye allow Xiao Ye to insult her at will? But this fierce character makes people shake their heads secretly.
Xiao Ye was too lazy to argue with Wu Meier, so he turned and left.
"Xiao Ye! Xiao Teng yelled angrily, "I hope you won't be a coward when it comes to marriage in two days!" "
If there were village rules in Xiaojia Village that juniors were not allowed to fight at will, he would have pounced on Xiao Ye and tore him into pieces.
Xiao Ye did not look back, and the faint words came into Xiao Teng's ears: "I will wait for you in the marriage selection arena. "
"Xiao Ye is going to participate in the marriage selection! "The onlookers took a breath of cold air.
How much courage it takes to participate in the marriage selection process without receiving a wedding invitation.
Xiao Ye returned to his room and sat cross-legged on the bed. With a slight thought, the true energy in his body surged through his meridians.
"I have now broken through to the first level of the acquired realm. If I want to continue to improve, I still need to develop a set of acquired skills. "Xiao YeThinking.
The basic combat skill Tiger Fist can only temper the body, but does not help in the slightest to strengthen the true energy in the body.
Acquired skills can temper and strengthen the true energy in the body. "Forget it, wait until after the marriage selection meeting to get it." Xiao Ye said to himself. Anyway, the divorce election meeting was only two days away, so he was not in a hurry.
In the early morning of the third day, when the sun cast its first beam of light, Xiao Ye, who was sitting on the bed, opened his eyes, then opened the door and walked out.
Outside the door, Henry Zhang and Luo Meilan were already ready.
"Ye'er, are you sure you want to participate in the marriage selection?" Henry Zhang asked again.
Going to participate in the marriage selection without receiving a wedding invitation will definitely become the laughing stock of others. He didn't care, he was afraid that Xiao Ye couldn't bear this kind of blow.
"Mom and dad, don't worry, I'm fine." Xiao Ye smiled faintly, his eyes were clear, and he whispered, "After today, no one will dare to laugh at us again."
